findings.finding: The de-SPAC Super 8-K, with the Form 10 information (post-closing capitalization, lock-ups, target financials and liquidity), is due by 2026-09-29, the fourth business day after the 2026-09-23 closing. The only post-closing 8-K so far carries items 7.01/8.01/9.01 and no 2.01.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Items 2.01(f)/9.01(c) require the Form 10 information within four business days of consummation. The closing was 2026-09-23 (Wed), so the deadline is Tue 2026-09-29, the next session. It lands in the window if it is accepted before the close. A filing accepted after 17:30 ET is dated 2026-09-30 and falls outside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has no prior post-closing 8-K. Its only primary-document day in the record is the 2026-09-23 closing 8-K with the redemption and trust figures, which fell 50.88% by close and was followed by -22.2%, -27.95% and -20% sessions (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The tape has only had the closing 8-K's trust figure ($2.2M) and no capitalization table. The quote aggregators in this search carried a cap of about $62M at $2.40, which fits roughly 26M shares. The S-4 implies about 108M+ shares, or about $215M at $2, for a pre-revenue developer with about $2.2M of trust cash. The FPA says a committed equity line S-1 is contemplated. A Super 8-K that states the real share count, lock-up dates and liquidity (and possibly an equity-line agreement) would move a retail-held, fundamentals-blind float against the price. If this were priced, the stock would not still be showing a sub-$70M cap on retail screens. The sizing is small because the content is mostly already in the S-4 and the filing may arrive after the window closes.
findings.independence: The prepaid forward agreement names a 'Form S-1 resale registration statement for a committed equity line of credit or similar facility' as a trigger, which fits more dilutive financing being planned: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1846416/000149315226043680/ex10-1.htm. The Super 8-K deadline rule: https://www.orrick.com/en/insights/2025/06/spac-re-attack-top-considerations-for-issuers-considering-a-de-spac-transaction

outside_window.finding: The New Circle prepaid forward (up to 5M shares, Initial Price about $10.60) matures 90 days after closing, about 2026-12-22. At maturity the seller keeps the prepayment and returns the shares, and an early-termination sale costs it the Reset Price (about $10.60 unless reduced by agreement). So the largest unredeemed block is not an economic seller at $2 unless the reset is cut. That would be a positive supply fact, but not a dated one.
A committed equity line / resale S-1 is contemplated in the FPA and would sell stock into any bounce. No agreement or S-1 is on file yet, so it has no date.

The lock-up on sponsor, directors, officers and the ONE Nuclear members (about 102M shares) is in Annex E; its duration was not found in the parts of the 424B3 I read. It is a dated supply release after the window.
Up to 13M earnout shares are issuable to the ONE Nuclear members under the 424B3; the triggers were not checked.
